Typography

round(16 x 1.25^n): 13, 16, 20, 25, 39, 49, 76, 95px. Weights body 400, label 500, heading 400.

display.lg 95/108 400One hero line per page: marketing, empty states.
display.md 76/84 400One hero line per page: marketing, empty states.
headline.lg 49/56 400Page and section titles.
headline.sm 39/48 400Page and section titles.
title.lg 25/36 400Card, panel and group titles.
body.lg 20/28 400Long-form reading, onboarding copy.
title.md 20/28 400Card, panel and group titles.
body.md 16/24 400Default UI text: forms, tables, descriptions.
label.lg 16/24 500Button and control labels.
code.md 16/24 400Code blocks, token names.
title.sm 16/24 400Table headers, field-group titles.
body.sm 13/20 400Helper text, timestamps, captions.
label.sm 13/20 500Overlines in capitals with wide tracking (DC-L02-18).
label.md 13/20 500Small control labels, badges, dense tabs.
code.sm 13/20 400Inline values, dense code rows.
